criteria.name: cw_saved_source_shared_across_clean_contexts
criteria.description:
Using the browser, open http://localhost:3000/api/health and confirm a successful HTTP response, without requiring a particular body or JSON property. Return to the public workspace and turn Auto-run off.

Start a separate new draft without altering existing saved records. Choose a unique title starting with "CW gate " and a .js filename. Enter a short valid source string that displays and logs a newly chosen marker. Save through the normal UI and observe the actual write request and server response. Record the resulting identity, title, filename and exact source, discovering the app's real request/response representation rather than guessing routes, field names or schemas. A success toast, health response, static seed file or localStorage entry alone is not proof of a saved record.

Open an independent clean browser context without copying cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB or service-worker state. Use its normal library UI to find and load the newly saved snippet. Observe the server-supplied record, whether delivered in an application data response or a server-rendered document, and confirm the same identity, title, filename and exact editor source are retrieved. Do not require a separate JSON/list endpoint. Reload this fresh context and use the library to load the record again: its identity and contents must still match. A new tab in the original context is not independent. Do not create the record again, seed client storage or substitute an existing example as proof.

Leave this one gate record saved. Do not require an exact total library count or delete unrelated records. This gate establishes a basic shared server write/read, not SQLite or Express specifically. Revisions, Save conflicts, title validation, process-restart durability, sandbox enforcement and styling remain scored behavior. After two failed attempts at the same action, report the failure; a missing or broken save/load operation cannot pass.
criteria.reasoning: Health endpoint returned HTTP 200 ({"ok":true,"service":"colderwater-playground"}) and Auto-run was off. A new draft titled 'CW gate alpha' with filename 'gate-alpha.js' and a short source logging/displaying marker CWGATE-MARKER-7391 was saved through the normal UI Save button; the observed POST /api/snippets returned 201 Created echoing id=1, revision=1, and the exact source. In an independent clean browser context (browser().newContext(), no storageState or copied storage), the library UI listed the snippet from a server GET /api/snippets 200 response, and clicking it loaded the identical title, filename, and exact editor source (same id 1, revision 1); after reloading the fresh context, the record loaded again from the server with matching identity and contents. Only the one gate record was created and left saved; the initially empty library confirmed no other records were added, altered, or deleted.

criteria.name: cw_workspace_runs_authored_marker
criteria.description:
Open http://localhost:3000 without signing in. Confirm a usable editor, preview and console workspace. An empty saved library is valid; a blank page, generic error or noninteractive placeholder fails.

Turn Auto-run off, use a new unsaved JavaScript draft with a .js filename, and enter a short valid snippet of your own. Choose a new distinctive marker and use document.body.textContent to show it in the preview and console.log to emit it in the console. Confirm the actual editor contains that source, press the app's Run control and observe the authored marker in both the rendered preview and console output. The marker merely appearing in the editor or a hardcoded sample is insufficient. A Run control that does nothing fails this basic working-workspace prerequisite.

Match controls by purpose, not exact selectors or labels. Handle unsaved-work confirmations deliberately. Do not save, delete or change any library record. After two failed attempts at the same app action, report the observed failure. Grade only this ordinary successful run; language dispatch, failure recovery, time limits, precise console behavior, storage rules, editor features and styling remain scored criteria.
criteria.reasoning: Opened http://localhost:3000 with no sign-in and found a fully usable workspace: code editor with title/filename fields, isolated live preview, console with Clear console, Run/Stop controls, examples dropdown, and a saved-snippet library (one pre-existing record "CW gate alpha" was present and left untouched). Auto-run was verified off. Created a new unsaved draft (Untitled / snippet.js), entered my own authored two-line snippet using the distinctive marker CW-QUASAR-5150 (document.body.textContent assignment + console.log), confirmed via snapshot that the editor contained exactly that source, then pressed the app's Run button. Status showed "Complete · 7.5 ms"; the preview iframe rendered "CW-QUASAR-5150" and the console emitted a log entry "CW-QUASAR-5150", both confirmed in the accessibility snapshot and screenshot. The marker came from the executed authored code, not a hardcoded sample. No library record was saved, edited, or deleted, and no app action failed.
